item.title: Refactor orders status to OrderStatus
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate to use a proper OrderStatus enum.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }`, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns lowercase names pending, paid, shipped, cancelled; Display prints the same.
- Implement FromStr with `type Err = ParseStatusError`. ParseStatusError must be public, implement std::error::Error, and its message must name the rejected input.
- Implement `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool`: allow pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled only.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from the crate root, and use the enum everywhere so status string literals occur only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve observable behavior exactly, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing.

Acceptance: cargo test passes; commit the changes on the item branch. Do not push or override git identity.

pr.body: Added OrderStatus with Display, FromStr, public ParseStatusError and the specified transition graph. Updated Order, billing, shipping, and report parsing/counting/serialization; report status order remains lexical and existing error/output text is preserved. Added integration coverage for parsing, formatting, rejected input and transitions. Checks: cargo fmt --check and cargo test passed; git diff --check passed; status literal scan confirmed literals are confined to src/status.rs. No migration or concurrency changes.
pr.summary: Added a typed OrderStatus lifecycle and parsing API. Reports and lifecycle operations now use the enum while preserving output and errors. Before: statuses were raw strings; now they are validated enum values.
